title: k8s-node-provisioning-debug-scratchpad
content:
Context / incident summary:
- Observed: new worker nodes (k8s 1.27) intermittently boot but stay in NotReady for 5-15 minutes after join. Some never become Ready without manual intervention. Affects dedicated-provisioning pipeline (helm chart: infra/nodepool) after auto-scaling events.
- Cluster: prod-dedicated-us-west, cloud: GCP (GKE custom node pools / self-managed nodes).
- First seen: 2024-11-06 16:12 UTC during a scale-up test.

Recent changes / suspects:
- Upgraded kubelet config bump (cgroupDriver: systemd) in node image build last week.
- Switch to containerd 1.8.4 -> 1.8.6 in image.
- Helm chart now applies node-init DaemonSet to pre-warm image cache.

Quick checks I ran (commands + notes):
- k get nodes -o wide  # shows NotReady nodes with 50% kernel version mismatch
- kubectl describe node <node-xxx> -> Last kubelet status: "KubeletNotReady" -> "container runtime is down"
- ssh to node (gcloud compute ssh): systemctl status kubelet -> active (running)
- sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 80 -> repeated: "E1107 08:23:01.123456  1234 kubelet.go:2345] Failed to start containerd: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to start shim: OCI runtime create failed: ... cgroup v2: mountpoint not found"
- sudo crictl ps -> CRI endpoint unresponsive (connection refused)
- sudo systemctl status containerd -> active (running) but logs show "failed to load runtime: runc not found in PATH"

Commands tried to reproduce / debug locally:
- sudo containerd --version -> containerd 1.8.6
- which runc -> /usr/sbin/runc (exists)
- ldd $(which runc) -> ok
- ls -la /sys/fs/cgroup/unified -> not mounted on some nodes (expected for cgroup v2)
- cat /proc/cmdline -> node boot args include systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1 on some nodes and absent on others -> discrepancy in image vs GCE instance template.

Error snippets captured:
- kubelet journal snippet:
  "E1107 08:23:01.123456 1234 remote_runtime.go:307] StartContainer failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to create container: failed to create task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: unable to apply cgroups: failed to write 0: no such file or directory: unknown"
- containerd journal snippet:
  "warn   runtime_shim    failed to start shim: error locating runc: exec: \"runc\": executable file not found in $PATH"

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Image-based mismatch: some node images (older image) boot with systemd cgroup v1 while newer image expects cgroup v2 -> containerd/kubelet mismatch causing CRI failures.
2) Init ordering race: node-init DaemonSet (pulling images / installing helpers) interferes with containerd/kubelet startup resulting in transient failure windows.
3) Missing runc or permission issue on certain image variants - but runc present on inspected nodes (yet containerd cannot find it due to PATH or selinux labeling).
4) Kernel / boot args inconsistent between instance template and image -> cgroup mountpoints inconsistent.

What I validated so far:
- Confirmed inconsistent /proc/cmdline between healthy vs unhealthy nodes. Healthy nodes show systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1; unhealthy do not.
- On unhealthy nodes, /sys/fs/cgroup/unified is missing; containerd falls back and fails.
- Searching image builder Jenkins logs: a step that toggles GRUB config (adds unified cgroup flag) was run only for the new-build job but not for the image-tagging job used by autoscaler.

Short-term mitigation executed:
- Re-deployed nodepool with a forced image rebuild that includes GRUB change -> new nodes come up Ready consistently (test group of 3).
- Added a startup script (GCE instance metadata startup-script) that ensures systemd.unified_cgroup_hierarchy=1 if missing as patch for rolling nodes.

Longer-term fixes to propose:
- Make image pipeline consistent: consolidate image tags and ensure GRUB kernel args applied across all builder paths (CI job INF-3421).
- Add a preflight check in node bootstrap that validates /sys/fs/cgroup/unified and fails early with clear logs to avoid kubelet log noise.
- Revisit DaemonSet ordering: move image-pull DaemonSet to run after kubelet is fully started (or use systemd unit) to avoid race.
- Add cluster-level alert: nodes in NotReady for > 5m after join -> auto cordon + drain + trigger a rebuild pipeline job.

Next steps / TODOs:
- [ ] Summarize findings in INF-3421 ticket + attach kernel cmdline diffs and builder job logs (Jordan to help with Jenkins access).
- [ ] Create minimal repro by launching two instance templates (with/without unified cgroup flag) and capture kubelet/containerd boot timelines.
- [ ] Iterate node image cookbook: add a smoke test step that boots an instance and checks /sys/fs/cgroup/unified presence.
- [ ] Add better logging in our node bootstrap to capture crictl status and containerd discovery errors.

Useful commands / snippets to re-run quickly:
- kubectl get nodes -owide | grep NotReady
- kubectl describe node <node> | sed -n '1,60p'
- gcloud compute ssh <node> --project=redwood-prod --zone=us-west1-b --command "sudo journalctl -u containerd -n 200 --no-pager"
- sudo journalctl -u kubelet -o cat --since "10 minutes ago"
- sudo cat /proc/cmdline
- ls -la /sys/fs/cgroup/unified || echo "no unified cgroup"
- sudo systemctl restart containerd && sudo crictl ps -a

Notes to self / breadcrumbs:
- Jordan saw a similar pattern in INF-3150 but that was caused by a badly packaged runc binary. This one smells like kernel cmdline mismatch.
- Keep this doc as scratchpad; will copy into the INF ticket and the runbook once verified.
- If someone from SRE / kernel team wants to pair, ping me (morgan.ross@redwood.ai).

End of scratchpad.
